train_pacenetwork: train a PaceNetwork model on motion capture spline dataset sequences with configurable batch size and epochs
predict_pacenetwork: predict amplitude frequency and direction tracks on a spline using a trained PaceNetwork model
extract_features_spline: extract curvature and speed input features or amplitude frequency direction output features from a spline
save_load_pacenetwork_weights: save or load PaceNetwork model weights to and from a file using torch state dict
compute_angle_operations: compute versor-based angle difference or angle sum between two 2D direction vectors using static methods
